title: PR body claims per-attempt draw counts unchanged; growth.odin and the decision log document one draw-count change (member pick)
detail: PR body asserts draw counts per attempt are unchanged; growth.odin and the decision log state the member-pick rng_range flips drawn→SKIPPED in the dead-slot collision case — exactly this diff's guard.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR parenthetical to 'unchanged except the live-member anchor pick (collision case)', matching growth.odin and the decision log.

title: Spec Design Notes repeat the 'draw counts unchanged' claim the code comment contradicts
detail: Design Notes say draw counts are unchanged and the anchor guard has 'no rng draws'; the code comment documents the member-pick rng_range flipping drawn→SKIPPED — the spec contradicts itself and the code.
recommended_fix: Update Design Notes to carve out the member-pick count change, mirroring the closures paragraph and the decision-log wording.

title: Cap-8 demo cited as 'grows estates to 8 before seeding a new area' shows no seed at all
evidence:
PR: "**The one-line cap change, demonstrated** (`max_members: 8` in balance.json,
`spawn-audit-after-cap8.txt`): the same seed run grows estates to **8**
members before seeding a new area — the cap is a data knob, one line." — vs the cited artifact's final audit: "  spawn #09 slot 11 ATTCH @ [13, 24]  nearest-earlier 4.00 tiles
  spawn #10 slot 12 ATTCH @ [28, 20]  nearest-earlier 4.00 tiles
  spawn #11 slot 13 ATTCH @ [23, 20]  nearest-earlier 5.00 tiles" (11 spawns, all ATTCH, zero SEED through t1760).
detail: The cap-8 capture ends with 11 ATTACH, 0 SEED; the [8,15] estate hit 8 at spawn #09 but no subsequent seed appears — 'before seeding a new area' is undemonstrated by the cited artifact.
recommended_fix: Extend the cap-8 run past the first post-cap seed window, or weaken the claim to 'estates grow to 8' — which the capture does show.

title: New test discards topo_setup's rt via '_ = rt' then re-fetches router_basic
evidence:
s, _, rt, _ := topo_setup(t, cat) // fixture: res slot 0, router slot 1, host slot 2
...
	basic, _ := node_type_index(cat, "router_basic")
	append(&s.action_log, Command{apply_tick = 1, kind = Cmd_Place_Router{type_idx = basic, pos = {34, 15}}})
	_ = rt
detail: `rt` is bound, silenced with `_ = rt`, and router_basic is re-fetched into `basic` — redundant lookup plus a dead-variable workaround in newly added test code.
recommended_fix: Use `rt` for the Cmd_Place_Router type_idx if it is the router type index (dropping the re-fetch and `_ = rt`), else discard it with `_` at binding.
